commands: kubectl get pods -n fleetcast -o wide && kubectl get events -n fleetcast --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -40
kubectl logs -n fleetcast -l app.kubernetes.io/component=backend --tail=80; kubectl logs -n fleetcast locust-fetcher --tail=30

kubectl logs -n fleetcast -l app=satellite-app-backend --tail=70; kubectl get networkpolicy,ingress -n fleetcast -o yaml; kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- ls -la /app
kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- cat /app/server.py; kubectl get pod locust-fetcher -n fleetcast -o yaml

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- python -c 'import urllib.request,time; base="http://fleetcast-satellite-app-backend:5000"; [(print(p,urllib.request.urlopen(base+p,timeout=20).status)) for p in ["/api/health","/api/dashboard","/api/station/GS-1"]]' ; kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend -- cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf; kubectl get endpoints -n fleetcast

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend -- sh -c 'ls /usr/share/nginx/html/static/js; grep -oE ".{0,120}(http://|https://|/api/).{0,160}" /usr/share/nginx/html/static/js/main*.js'

kubectl get svc -n fleetcast -o wide; kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- python -c 'import urllib.request; u="http://fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend/api/dashboard"; r=urllib.request.urlopen(u); print(r.status,r.headers.get("Content-Type"),r.read(100))'; kubectl logs -n fleetcast -l app=satellite-app-backend --since=5m --tail=-1 | rg -i 'error|exception|failed|traceback' | tail -25

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- python -c 'import urllib.request,json; base="http://fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend"; [(print(p,r.status,r.headers.get("Content-Type"),len(r.read()))) for p in ["/","/api/health","/api/dashboard","/api/station/GS-1"] for r in [urllib.request.urlopen(base+p,timeout=20)]]'; kubectl get pods -n fleetcast
kubectl get pods -n fleetcast; kubectl get events -n fleetcast --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -10

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- python -c 'import urllib.request,json; hosts=["fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend","10.244.162.153"]; base="http://fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend"; [(print(p,r.status,r.headers.get("Content-Type")),json.load(r)) for p in ["/api/health","/api/dashboard","/api/station/GS-1"] for r in [urllib.request.urlopen(base+p,timeout=20)]]'; kubectl get deploy -n fleetcast
agent.summary:
Fixed frontend API routing: Nginx returned React HTML for `/api/*` requests. Added a persistent ConfigMap proxying those requests to the backend and rolled out both frontend replicas.

Verified health, dashboard, and station endpoints return HTTP 200 with JSON through the frontend. Both deployments are healthy at 2/2 replicas.
